name: Brajhan Luna-Vazquez
crime: Convicted: Brajhan Luna-Vazquez, 24, of Mexico, residing illegally in Millcreek, Utah, a previously removed illegal alien from Mexico, was sentenced to two years' imprisonment for possession with intent to distribute fentanyl after approximately 11,000 fentanyl pills were recovered.
usa: DOJ release Nov 9, 2026: Illegal Alien from Mexico Sentenced to Prison for Drug Trafficking in the District of Utah
text: DOJ Nov 9, 2026, as posted: A previously removed illegal alien from Mexico was sentenced today to two years' imprisonment for drug trafficking crimes after law enforcement recovered approximately 11,000 individual fentanyl pills in the District of Utah. Brajhan Luna-Vazquez, 24, of Mexico, residing illegally in Millcreek, Utah, pleaded guilty on August 31, 2026, to possession with intent to distribute fentanyl.

name: Federico Sanchez Alvarado
crime: Convicted: Federico Sanchez Alvarado, 29, a citizen of Mexico, an illegal alien, was sentenced to 21 months in prison for illegal reentry after deportation/removal and illegal alien in possession of a firearm.
usa: DOJ release Nov 9, 2026: OPERATION TAKE BACK AMERICA: Previously Removed Illegal Alien Sentenced to Prison for Immigration and Firearm Offenses
text: DOJ Nov 9, 2026, as posted: An illegal alien has been sentenced for immigration and firearm offenses. U.S. District Court Judge Anna M. Manasco sentenced Federico Sanchez Alvarado, 29, a citizen of Mexico, to 21 months in prison. Sanchez pleaded guilty to illegal reentry after deportation/removal and illegal alien in possession of a firearm. He was ordered removed on February 10, 2016, and deported on August 16, 2016.

name: Dexing Zhang
crime: Charged: Dexing Zhang, 40, a Chinese national residing in Naples, is charged with attempted sex trafficking of a minor after he was arrested at a hotel in Davie.
usa: DOJ release Nov 9, 2026: Chinese National Charged with Attempted Sex Trafficking of a 15-Year-Old Girl
text: DOJ Nov 9, 2026, as posted: A Chinese national has been charged with attempting to sex traffic a 15-year-old girl. According to court records, Dexing Zhang, 40, residing in Naples, was arrested at a hotel after driving from Naples to meet the purported minor. Zhang is charged with attempted sex trafficking of a minor.
